questions.question:
[01] 다음 글을 읽고, 물음에 답하시오.

Eckels walked into the office of Time Travel. The big sign on the wall said, "NAME ANY YEAR IN THE PAST. WE TAKE YOU THERE." There was a TV on the wall, and Mr. Keith, the new president, was ⓐ ______ the news.

"How can we help you?" said Mr. Parker, the founder of Time Travel.

"I've always wanted to see a dinosaur. Is ⓑit possible?" asked Eckels.

"Sure," said Mr. Parker. "We can take you back to the jungle of 60 million years ago."

"Great," said Eckels. "Can you take me there now?"

"You're lucky. (A)," said Mr. Parker.

"This is Travis, your travel guide," he continued. "To stay ______, you must follow his instructions."

윗글의 빈칸 ⓐ에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explainKo: on the news는 '뉴스에 나오는, 보도되는'이라는 뜻이다.

questions.explainKo: it은 바로 앞 문장의 to see a dinosaur를 가리킨다.

[03] 다음 글을 읽고, 물음에 답하시오.

"You're lucky. (A) 10분 후에 출발하는 타임머신이 있습니다." said Mr. Parker.

윗글의 밑줄 친 (A)의 우리말을 다음 조건에 맞게 바르게 영작하시오.
조건
1. a time machine, in, leave, there를 이용하되 필요시 어형을 바꿀 것.
2. 관계대명사를 사용할 것.
3. 축약형을 사용하여 총 9단어로 쓸 것.
answers: There's a time machine that leaves in 10 minutes.
There's a time machine which leaves in 10 minutes.
There is a time machine that leaves in 10 minutes.
There is a time machine which leaves in 10 minutes.
questions.explainKo: There's a time machine that[which] leaves in 10 minutes. 관계대명사 that 또는 which가 a time machine을 수식한다.

questions.question:
[06] 다음 글을 읽고, 물음에 답하시오.

Inside the time machine, there were two other travelers. Eckels sat down and closed his eyes. He felt the machine ⓐmoved under his feet.
"We've just arrived in the jungle of 60 million years ago," Travis explained.
"Do you see the path over there? You must not leave it at any time. (A) Do not touch anything. You might kill something by accident. A little change here can cause ⓑsomething unthinkable in the future."
Slowly, everyone got out of the time machine. The jungle ⓒwas covered in fog. It was very quiet.
"I'm so excited," said Eckels.
"Be careful. Some of the dinosaurs are hungry," said Travis. "Just stay ⓓcalm. (B) 저는 당신이 어떠한 바보 같은 행동도 하지 않길 바랍니다."
"Don't worry. I'm not a fool," said Eckels.
They all began ⓔto walk on the path.

윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
questions.explainKo: 지각동사 feel의 목적격보어는 현재분사 moving 또는 동사원형 move가 와야 한다. ⓐ moved가 틀렸다.

questions.question:

"I'm so excited," said Eckels.

"Be careful. Some of the dinosaurs are hungry," said Travis. "Just stay calm. (B) 바보 같은 행동도 하지 않길 바랍니다." (⑤)

"Don't worry. I'm not a fool," said Eckels.

They all began to walk on the path.

윗글의 ①~⑤ 중 다음 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은?

After only a few minutes, the machine stopped.
questions.explainKo: 주어진 문장은 불과 몇 분 후에 타임머신이 멈추었다는 내용으로, 타임머신이 멈춘 뒤 6천만 년 전의 정글에 도착했다는 말이 이어지는 것이 자연스러우므로 ①에 들어가는 것이 가장 적절하다.

questions.explainKo: 바로 뒤의 두 문장에 이유가 나와 있다. 과거를 변화시키는 작은 행동이 미래에 상상할 수 없는 결과를 초래할 수도 있으므로 아무것도 건드리지 말라고 하였다.

(foolish, anything, do)

answers: I don't want you to do anything foolish.

questions.question:
[12] 다음 글을 읽고, 물음에 답하시오.

ⓐAfter some time, Travis whispered, "Look over there. There is a T. rex."

One hundred meters away, a T. rex ⓑslowly appeared.

"It," whispered Eckels. "It..."

"Sh!"

"It... is huge. (A) I've never seen such a huge thing. I'm so (B) ______," said Eckels.

"Sh... quiet!" Travis said angrily. "You don't want it to see you."

"I ⓒcan't breathe," said Eckels. "Get me out of here!"

"ⓓDon't panic, Eckels," said Travis. "ⓔTurn around, and walk quietly back to the machine."

Eckels turned around and started to run. He was so terrified that he left the path (C) 실수로.

윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ의 뜻풀이가 바르지 않은 것은?
questions.explainKo: ⓓ Don't panic은 '겁먹지 마라'라는 뜻이다. panic은 몹시 겁에 질려 어쩔 줄 모르다라는 뜻이다.

questions.question:
[16] 다음 글을 읽고, 물음에 답하시오.

[A]
"Eckels!" shouted Travis. "Don't leave the path!"
The T. rex heard Travis and turned its head toward him and the other travelers. There (a)[was / were] a moment of silence. Then, it suddenly started to run toward them with a loud roar.
"Run, everybody! Run!" shouted Travis.

[B]
Travis and the other travelers returned safely to the machine and found Eckels inside.

"You put all of us ⓐ ______ danger," said Travis to Eckels in an angry voice. "You left the path."

"I'm sorry, but I didn't kill (b)[anything / nothing]," said Eckels. "There's only (c)[a few / a little] mud on my shoes."

Travis stared ⓑ ______ Eckels for a long time without saying anything.

"Let's go home," said Travis finally.

윗글 [A]의 분위기로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explainKo: 공룡의 추격을 당하는 위험한 상황이므로 ④ '긴장되고 무서운' 분위기이다. ① 슬프고 우울한 ② 조용하고 평화로운 ③ 흥미진진하고 즐거운 ⑤ 따뜻하고 희망찬
